summary: Proposes a simple method for workstations to dynamically fetch mail from a mailbox server, which became known as POP3 (Post Office Protocol version 3). It was published as a proposal asking for discussion and improvements. It was replaced by RFC 1225.

eli5.summary: Your mail waits in a big mailbox at a post office. This lets your own computer walk up, ask for your letters, and bring them home.

questions: post office protocol version 3 original spec
